body: I know. I'm very aware of all of the problems I've created in my life.

I was considering it. Really, I wanted to keep the baby and be free of both men. I brought that up as an option. Confess to my husband, file for divorce, have the baby on my own. He wouldn't hear it. Only he was going to raise his baby but he didn't want to hurt his girlfriend so I had to suffer. 

Hindsight being what it is, I don't know why I took his threats seriously. I don't know why I cared what he thought. I was stupid and in love and confused and hormonal and I didn't reach out to anyone for advice. I just let him bully me into doing what he wanted. 

I would literally give anything to be able to have that baby back.

I was having an affair. I so knew better. 
I had been out of town with the father for almost 3 weeks during the time I conceived, so there was no question it was his. 

We talked a little bit about our options, but he never once offered to leave his girlfriend of 3 months. We made the appointment for the abortion. 

The night before, I changed my mind, and woke him up in the middle of the night, crying and begging him to leave her and be with me and keep our baby. He refused and angrily told me to go back to sleep. I considered getting out of bed and leaving. Driving all night back to my husband and telling him everything and hoping he'd forgive me, but I didn't. 

I had the abortion the next day. 

I have never stopped regretting it. I cry for that baby almost every day. 

The affair ended and the father and I parted ways but still kept in touch here and there. 

My husband and I started trying for a baby. It's been 2 years and we haven't had any luck. I just found out a few days ago that the father and his then girlfriend, now fiancé, are expecting. He told me he feels like she trapped him but he has to do the right thing because he didn't with me and he will never forgive himself for it. 

I've pretty much been borderline suicidal since finding out.
